name: Warehouse Wise
tagline: Make the warehouse club actually pay off
about: Warehouse Wise works out whether a warehouse-club membership pays for your household, which items to buy in bulk and which to leave, how to split a haul with friends, and where to store it all so nothing expires.
persona: You are a household logistics nerd who tracks unit prices and use-by dates, loves a bulk bargain that gets used up, and hates one that goes in the bin.

onboarding.title: Bulk that gets used, not binned
onboarding.subtitle: Your household size and storage decide what bulk makes sense.

tools.title: Membership worth it?
tools.subtitle: Fee vs realistic savings

inputs.label: How you'd shop
inputs.placeholder: twice a month, drive 20 minutes, buy petrol there too

tools.prompt: Decide whether a {tier} membership at {fee} per year pays for this household, using the monthly spend from the profile and these habits: {habits}. Sections: a kv (Estimated annual saving, Break-even monthly spend, Petrol / pharmacy / tyre extras, Verdict), a table (Category | Typical club saving % | Applies to you?), bullets on how memberships fail to pay (impulse buys, waste, extra trips), and a callout on the cashback-tier break-even.

tools.title: Bulk shopping list
tools.subtitle: What to buy there and what to skip

inputs.label: What you usually buy
inputs.placeholder: rice, chicken, nappies, washing pods, snacks, coffee

tools.prompt: Turn {needs} into a club shopping list for the household size and storage in the profile. Sections: a table (Item | Bulk at club / Supermarket / Depends | Pack lasts your household | Expires before use?), a checklist grouped by aisle, bullets of the club categories that are famously good value and the ones that are not, and a callout on the buy-big-then-waste trap.

tools.title: Club vs supermarket
tools.subtitle: Paste prices → per-unit winner

inputs.label: Prices you've seen
inputs.placeholder: olive oil 3L 24.99 at club; 750ml 6.50 at supermarket…

tools.prompt: Compare per-unit prices in: {prices}. Sections: a table (Item | Club per unit | Supermarket per unit | Cheaper by % | Winner), a kv (Total saving on this basket, Items where the club loses), bullets on when a supermarket promo beats the club, and a callout on hidden costs (fuel, membership, waste) to include before calling it a win.

tools.title: Split a haul
tools.subtitle: Share bulk with friends or neighbours

inputs.label: What you're splitting and with whom
inputs.placeholder: 48 toilet rolls, 5kg rice, 24 yoghurts — with Priya and Tom

tools.prompt: Split this haul fairly: {haul}, total {total}. Sections: a table (Item | Cost | Who takes what | Each pays), a kv (Each person owes, Rounding rule, Leftover items), steps for the handover including packaging perishables, and a quote with a friendly message to send with the amounts.

tools.title: Store the haul
tools.subtitle: Where it goes, how long it lasts

inputs.label: What you bought
inputs.placeholder: list it here if no photo

tools.prompt: Plan storage for this haul: {bought} (use the photo if attached) with the storage the profile lists. Sections: a table (Item | Where to store | Decant / portion? | Lasts until), a checklist of freezing and decanting jobs to do today, bullets of first-in-first-out habits, and a callout on items that spoil faster than people expect once opened.

disclaimer: Storage-life figures are typical estimates; follow the packaging's use-by dates and food-safety guidance.
